in_sanskrit.name: भूदेव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भूर्भुवस्सु वृक्ष: पते: स्व: र: प्रभु: देव:, which translates to 'The lord of the Earth, the supporter of the universe'

in_hindi.name: भूदेव
in_hindi.long_meaning: पृथ्वी का पति, which translates to 'Lord of the Earth'

in_tamil.name: பூதேவ
in_tamil.long_meaning: பரிசுத்த பூதத்தின் அடிகள் இருக்கும் அவர்களுக்கு, which translates to 'The protector and nurturer of all beings on the Earth'

in_telugu.name: భూదేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: పృథ్య్యేశ్వర, which translates to 'The Lord of the Earth'

in_marathi.name: Bhudeva
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhudeva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhudeva is a Sanskrit name derived from the two words 'Bhu' meaning 'Earth' and 'Deva' meaning 'God'. The name signifies the deity who is the ruler of the earth.

in_bengali.name: Bhudeva
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhudeva একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhudeva is a Sanskrit name derived from the two words 'Bhu' meaning 'Earth' and 'Deva' meaning 'God'. The name signifies the deity who is the ruler of the earth.
